text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
W-What unbelievable strength...! An 
absolute monarchy, completely unshakable!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: This is the Tyrant—Orfevre!!!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I am the one who— Namely, is King.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Illuminated by a sudden burst of strong 
evening sunlight, Orfevre's figure gleamed 
in radiant gold—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was captivated by that dignified 
figure.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: It's beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Orfe, Orfe, Orfe! ...Parfait~~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm really not in the mood for French 
cuisine. Dessert first it is!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let's return to the schedule as it should 
be. —I take full responsibility for 
stopping her.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Orfe-san...! I'm gonna be like that too—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I shall prove myself as the star. —The 
bloom of the new era that follows yours.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—No, this can't be happening!! I won't let 
it end like this...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "No way! Because, her... Her rival is me!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Just you wait, King. I'm going to put 
an end to the story where you're the main 
character!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. That's good. It looks like 
everyone will fulfill their roles nicely.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Orfe. Your reign is secure. 
Because..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Not a single person will ever write— —that 
your era was boring.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As long as your journey continues... my 
dream won't end either—

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah...! Orfevre is just so strong after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
You're so cool! I wonder if I can meet you 
someday? Until then—I'll always, always be 
cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre really is... so strong...! How can 
anyone be this powerful...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"...I just can't do it after all. Not 
believing in her... is impossible for me!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfeeeeevre! Next year, the world... will 
be yours!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Expectations swell... That this time, 
their king... would conquer the world. At 
that moment—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Silence.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall speak.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Now then... My people. My subjects.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I command you all. Pass down the glory of 
the King for all eternity.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
My majesty shall not decay. It will not 
fade. —It shall never perish.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Prostrate before the blazing halo. Revere 
this noble name.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —My name is Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The world will be trampled beneath these 
legs!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohh...!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that instant, an explosive cheer 
erupts... and for a moment, my eyes meet 
Orfevre's.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The sound fades. Just the two of us... in 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The King raised a hand in the air. As if 
to receive it reverently— I held out both 
hands and fell to my knees.
